analysis: PetalPal in-domain v1 Candidate C-Lite INT8 failure analysis

classificationMethod.category1: No best/acceptable label passed threshold, and no label reached 75% of its threshold; also includes false positives on abstention gold.
classificationMethod.category2: No best/acceptable label passed, but at least one reached >=65% of its current threshold (diagnostic near-miss only; not a tuning recommendation).
classificationMethod.category3: A best/acceptable label passed but selector removed it, or an accepted output was accompanied by an output/count-policy violation.
classificationMethod.categories4to6: Non-exclusive evidence tags layered on the mechanical category; proportions may overlap.
